patch.value: GH-844: local npm package archives are rejected as install sources
Accept bounded local npm package archives as first-class package install sources while preserving provenance and enforcing extraction safety before manifest and entrypoint validation.

Accept npm .tgz and .tar.gz package archives through the public SDK and pm package install; Bound extracted entry count and bytes and reject traversal, escaping links, unsupported roots, and ambiguous manifests; Preserve original archive provenance in managed package metadata; Cover npm and Bun offline temp-workspace installation on POSIX and Windows-safe paths
pm-cli 2026.7.31; npm pack tarball; offline fresh workspace
pm package install accepts safe local .tgz and .tar.gz npm package archives, validates a bounded extraction, preserves archive provenance, and behaves consistently through SDK and CLI surfaces.
The local source validator requires a directory and rejects a standard npm package archive with Local extension source must be a directory.
